user.title: Connect charger via local OCPP
user.description: The charger will connect directly to Home Assistant (OCPP 1.6). The Easee cloud keeps working in parallel. Select the charger:

prerequisites.title: Check requirements – {charger}
prerequisites.description:
{firmware_check} Firmware {firmware} (344 or newer required)
{wifi_check} Connected via Wi-Fi (over cellular the charger cannot reach Home Assistant)
{operator_check} Operator of the site: {operator} (must be Easee; change it in the Easee app if not)
{circuit_check} No dynamic circuit limit below the fuse rating

Important: while OCPP is active the charger only starts charging after Home Assistant accepted the RFID card. Make sure your cards are listed in the integration options (Configure → RFID cards).

data.reset_circuit_limit: Lift the dynamic circuit limit to the fuse rating

data_description.reset_circuit_limit: Otherwise the circuit limit from the cloud keeps capping the OCPP limits.

address.title: Address of Home Assistant – {charger}
address.description: The charger connects to this address and appends /{serial}. It must be reachable from the charger's network: use the IP address or a name your router resolves (no .local names). Port 8123 is Home Assistant's own port, nothing else has to be opened. The connection is unencrypted (ws://) with a generated password, because Easee only accepts TLS certificates from a public CA.

connection_failed.title: {charger} did not connect
connection_failed.description: The charger has not connected to {url} within 10 minutes. Possible causes: the address is not reachable from the charger's network (firewall, VLAN, wrong IP), the name cannot be resolved, or the charger is offline. Sometimes it just takes longer.

menu_options.rollback: Cancel and switch the charger back to cloud only
menu_options.finish: Save anyway (the charger may connect later)

progress.wait_for_charger: OCPP is being enabled for {charger} via the Easee cloud. Waiting until the charger connects to {url}. This usually takes a few minutes (up to 10).
